sn22.62:1.2: The three “scopes” or “ranges” (_patha_) are the past, present, and future, each of which is indicated by the appropriate grammatical tense.| _Nirutti_ means the “clear expression” or “definition” of a word. In the pre-Buddhist literature, that which is “undefined” is the mystical truth to be muttered under the breath, whereas that which is “defined” is clearly expressed in language. A list of such definitions is a _nirukti_, a glossary or dictionary. See [dn15:32.11](), [mn139:13.55](), [an5.169:3.6]().
